The snail takes **28 days** to reach the top of the 30-foot well.

**Explanation:**  
Each day/night cycle, the snail climbs a net of 1 foot (3 feet up during the day, 2 feet down at night). However, on the final day, the snail climbs 3 feet and escapes without sliding back. So, the snail needs to reach 27 feet by the end of a day, which takes 27 days (27 feet × 1 foot per day/night cycle). On the 28th day, it climbs the remaining 3 feet and reaches the top.
